Documento cartográfico complementar ao Objeto 0602 do Programa de Gestão de Riscos e Resposta a Desastres Naturais, incluído no Plano Plurianual 2012-2015 do Ministério do Planejamento, Orçamento e Gestão. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
